verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'import re; from pathlib import Path; text=Path("docs/operations/mcp-production-readiness-evidence.md").read_text(); keys=("evidence_binding_status","tls_edge","backup_restore","scaling_rollback_incident","otlp","multiworker","public_acceptance","publication_status","production_gate_status","deployment_revision","immutable_registry_digest","named_production_approver"); values={}; [values.setdefault(key, []).append(value.strip()) for key, value in re.findall(r"^([a-z_]+): (.+)$", text, re.M) if key in keys]; assert all(len(values.get(key, [])) == 1 for key in keys); expected={"evidence_binding_status":"COMPLETE","tls_edge":"PASS","backup_restore":"PASS","scaling_rollback_incident":"PASS","otlp":"PASS","multiworker":"PASS","public_acceptance":"PASS","publication_status":"APPROVED","production_gate_status":"APPROVED"}; assert all(values[key][0] == value for key, value in expected.items()); assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", values["deployment_revision"][0]); assert re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", values["immutable_registry_digest"][0]); assert values["named_production_approver"][0] not in {"","NOT_ASSIGNED"}'
